svg.title: Shapes and brushes
svg.desc: A mask and a material rule remain independent until fill composes them into block states.

text.tspan: Where and what are separate decisions.

g.title: Shape answers where
g.desc: The sphere is only a boolean mask over voxel centres. It knows nothing about block states.

g.title: Brush answers what
g.desc: The brush maps position or field values to block states without deciding which cells exist.

g.title: fill composes the two contracts
g.desc: BuildingTool.fill visits the selected cells and asks the brush for one block state at each position.

text.tspan: A reusable shape can take any brush, and a reusable brush can paint any bounded shape.
